title: One Thursday and Thirty Years
subtitle: 社区与社群 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区与社群（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区与社群（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：community　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 community 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my grandmother ① joined the local community with nothing but a chair and a pan, and she said the joining was the whole of the arriving. The ② community, meaning the people and not the street, met on a Thursday and stayed that way; community, she said, is the only thing in a new town that is judged by how quickly it answers.

Every ③ community on that road had the same notice board, and the ④ community at the end, meaning the one she kept for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Community, my mother said, is nine parts answering and one part somebody willing to knock; my grandmother said the knocking is the part that fills the board.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the scientific community was the whole of the letter, meaning the people who read it and not the street. The ⑥ community, meaning those people and not any of that, is the only thing in a letter that everybody writes for and nobody names; community, he said, is either something you join or the only word that means both a street and a set of readers. She said the readers are the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ community had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about who counted. The ⑧ community of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in June, was one Thursday and thirty years of knocking; community, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to answer. He said the answering was never mentioned.

The ⑨ community I remember is the one at the end, which she joined in 1969 and is still described as the quickest in the county. A ⑩ community, my mother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being thanked; every community, she said, is a belonging that has agreed to look like a street. She said the belonging was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 社区（指那些人本身，与那条街道相对）
C. 固定搭配：the local community 当地社区
D. n. 社区（指那条路上每一个）
E. n. 社区（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 界；群体（指有共同特征的一群人，the scientific community）
G. n. 社区（指调查里提到的那一个）
H. n. 共同体意识；归属感（抽象总称）

items.q: joined the local community with nothing but a chair
The community, meaning the people and not the street
the scientific community was the whole of the letter
the community had become a line in a survey
The community of the whole thing
A community, my mother said in 1971

answers.why: the local community 意为“当地社区”，1955 年祖母只带一把椅子一口锅加入了当地社区。
community 意为“社区”，指那些人本身而不是那条街道，他们在星期四聚会。
community 指那条路上每一个社区，每一个都有同样的公告栏。
community 指末尾那一个（她留给冬天的那一个），是唯一有人谢过两次的。
the scientific community 意为“科学界”，父亲说科学界就是那封信的全部，指的是读信的那些人。
community 为抽象用法，指有共同特征的那一群人而不是那条街道，是信里人人都为之写作、却无人点名的东西。
community 意为“社区”，指调查里提到的那一个，到 1963 年这个社区成了调查里的一行。
community 意为“共同体意识、归属感”，祖母六月写道，整件事的归属感是一个星期四三十年的敲门。
community 意为“社区”，我记得的是末尾那一个，她 1969 年加入，至今仍被说成全县回应最快的。
community 为抽象总称，母亲说一个社区是唯一会因为被致谢而变好的东西。

Every community on that road had the same notice board.
The community at the end, meaning the one she kept for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
